title: CONGA: Compiling Gaussian Fiber Geometry for Structured Bayesian Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.20995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In structured Bayesian models, a large latent block is often Gaussian conditional on a smaller set of parameters, yet generic inference methods relearn this geometry during warmup. We study how this structure can be used to construct transports for posterior inference. The conditional mean and precision determine exact affine maps, including symmetric Brenier and triangular Knothe-Rosenblatt maps, that separate a standard normal block from the remaining non-Gaussian core. KL and relative Fisher objectives then reduce to objectives on this core. We introduce CONGA, a compiler that identifies candidate Gaussian blocks and selects a temporal, spectral, or sparse implementation according to their structure and computational cost. Marginalization requires an identity established from the model; numerical evidence alone permits only a target-preserving change of variables, and a failed check leaves the model unchanged. translated_title: CONGA：为结构化贝叶斯推断编译高斯纤维几何
translated_abstract: 在结构化贝叶斯模型中，一个较大的潜变量块在给定较小参数集的条件下通常服从高斯分布，然而通用的推断方法往往需要在预热阶段重新学习这一几何结构。我们研究如何利用这一结构来构建用于后验推断的传输映射。条件均值和精度矩阵确定了精确的仿射映射，包括对称Brenier映射和三角形Knothe-Rosenblatt映射，它们将一个标准正态块与其余的非高斯核心分离开来。KL散度和相对Fisher目标随之约化为该核心上的目标函数。我们提出了CONGA——一个编译器，它识别候选的高斯块，并根据其结构与计算成本选择时间型、谱型或稀疏型实现方式。边缘化需要从模型本身建立恒等式；仅有数值证据时，只允许进行保持目标分布的变量替换，而检查失败时模型保持不变。在Stock-Watson宏观数据（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CONGA编译器，通过识别结构化贝叶斯模型中的条件高斯潜变量块，并利用精确仿射传输映射（Brenier和Knothe-Rosenblatt映射）将其与非高斯核心分离，从而将KL与相对Fisher推断目标约化到低维核心上以提升后验推断效率。
en_tdlr: CONGA is a compiler that identifies conditionally Gaussian latent blocks in structured Bayesian models and uses exact affine transports (symmetric Brenier and triangular Knothe-Rosenblatt maps) to separate them from the non-Gaussian core, reducing KL and relative Fisher objectives to the low-dimensional core for more efficient posterior inference.
